messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Adjusting point size and color with plotspec()
parts:
Not exactly a bug, but some limited programming in the geomorph code. Thanks for identifying this, Stefan.

I´ve amended the function such that you can now pass arguments directly to plot3d of rgl. Note that to make that happen, I´ve also added some arguments, so please check the new help file and may make some adjustments to your code for defining plotting parameters for fixed and surface landmarks. Please give it a go and let me know if something does not work.

You need to install from the Develop branch of geomorph on github, i.e. devtools::install_github("geomorphR/geomorph", ref = "Develop")

Cheers,

Antigoni

Hi Antigoni, 

Great, thank you for updating the function! However, I am not able yet to test the function because the installment of the latest geomorph package changed my PCA script that is required for the plotspec() visualization. I see plotTangentSpace() is changed to gm.prcomp() (I like the addition of phylogenetics and im curious to test it out). However, I used bilat.symmetry() to extract the symmetric component of shape (works good) as input for the PCA. Now I get an error when I try to do a PCA with gm.prcomp() and the symmetric component of shape as input (see attached image). Also, the groups = argument from plotTangentSpace() is absent in gm.prcomp(). Is it possible to incorporate this argument in gm.prcomp()? I was looking if this argument was available in the new function plot.gm.prcomp() which is suggested in the help file of gm.prcomp(), however this function appears to be unrecognizable by R and therefore I was not able to test it (see second attached image). 

Maybe you are right in the development with these functions, but these are the things I encounter presently. 

Best regards, 

Stefan

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Adjusting point size and color with plotspec()
parts:
Stefan,

please reinstall from the Stable branch on github, which is where I should have pointed you at from the beginning for the new version of plotspec.

As for gm.prcomp, please do not use that function or try to test it quite yet. It is still under development, which is in part evident from the fact that it is not working for you (because you are missing some other pieces not available to you at present). For this function you will need to wait until the release of the next version of geomorph on CRAN.

As for plotting, group plotting or any other kind of plotting options will be available for that function through calls to basic plot() arguments (e.g. bg = mygroups).

Antigoni
